name: Warcraft Reborn Shaman Rockbiter Weapon (1108017) enchants the equipped weapon (#7834)
contract: Rockbiter Weapon 1108017 (Warcraft Reborn Shaman, class 7): SpellFamilyName SHAMAN, FamilyFlags[0] 0x400000 (the stock Rockbiter family signature), effect 1 = SPELL_EFFECT_ENCHANT_ITEM_TEMPORARY with MiscValue 10029 (SpellItemEnchantment: +12 attack power), damage 101.

Spell::EffectEnchantItemTmp (SpellEffects.cpp) special-cases the stock Rockbiter Weapon ranks by mapping their Effect[1] base-value damage to a hardcoded enchant spell id, gated by `GetSpellTwinSource(id) == id`. That check answers true both for a genuine stock rank and for any spell SpellMgr never registered as anybody's twin, since GetSpellTwinSource falls back to identity. 1108017 is not registered as a twin, so it took the hardcoded branch, whose switch has no case for damage 101, logging 'Damage 101 not handled in S'RW' and returning without enchanting the weapon at all.

Reproduced before the fix: casting 1108017 on an equipped weapon left temp enchant slot 1 (TEMP_ENCHANTMENT_SLOT) at 0 and logged that error. The fix adds `m_spellInfo->Id < 100000` to the branch's guard (CoA custom spell ids are all 100000 and above), so 1108017 now falls through to the generic enchant path and applies its own MiscValue enchant 10029.

steps.label: SETUP: the weapon has no temp enchant yet
Rockbiter Weapon enchants the equipped weapon with its own enchant 10029
